step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays Fortinet's FortiWeb Cloud WAF solution deployed across AWS regions (US-WEST-1 and EU-CEN-1). CloudFront acts as the global entrance and CDN layer, serving static content from S3. S3 connects to API Gateway, which fronts AWS Lambda functions handling customer management and configuration updates. Lambda pushes configurations to both the regional FortiWeb Cloud Cluster (third-party security cluster) and stores configuration in DynamoDB. Additionally, Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) sits centrally to handle log offloading for fast filtering and analytics across regions. Visual green arrows indicate the request flow within US-WEST-1 from CloudFront -> S3 -> API Gateway -> Lambda -> FortiWeb Cloud Cluster & DynamoDB.
